segments.title: Station Cold-Open & Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the top-of-hour broadcast sign-on and identifies as the dog producer before handing off to Trent.

segments.title: Bubble Ghost Game Boy Advance Playthrough
segments.notes: Trent (Case Blackwell) plays through the Game Boy Advance version of Bubble Ghost using save states, completing all 35 halls after extended difficulty spikes and spider/butthole mechanics.

segments.title: Twinsons Odyssey (Little Big Adventure 2) First Look
segments.notes: Trent purchases and begins the GOG version of Twinsons Odyssey, struggling with tank controls, prison escape sequence, and disguise mechanics while recalling Case's 1997 playthrough.

segments.title: Royal Rumble 2025 Co-Stream Attempt
segments.notes: Trent attempts to share the Peacock broadcast of the Royal Rumble via Discord screen-share, navigating audio issues and DMCA concerns before settling on audio-only commentary.

segments.title: Raid & Sign-Off
segments.notes: Trent ends the Twitch stream and raids Serlar, directing viewers to the cream.team Discord for continued Royal Rumble coverage.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors the gaming broadcast as "Trent," completing Bubble Ghost and starting Twinsons Odyssey while commenting on Royal Rumble.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivers the station cold-open and sign-on before departing as Trent takes over the broadcast.

characters.name: Chris
characters.notes: Serves as Trent's parole officer and co-commentator throughout the gaming session, offering advice and distraction.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Calls in during the Royal Rumble watch party, prompting a brief off-mic conversation.

characters.name: Peter Gibbon
characters.notes: news stowaway. Referenced as "Papito" loose in the studio crawlspaces during the cold open.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: recurring. Mentioned as potentially circling the building searching for the broadcast location.

lore_notes.fact: Case Blackwell's credit card used to purchase Twinsons Odyssey bundle on GOG
Case Blackwell previously played Twinsons on a Packard Bell computer in 1997
Royal Rumble 2025 men's winner confirmed as Seth Rollins
Broadcast concludes with raid to Serlar's channel

episode_summary: Trent (Case Blackwell) hosts a gaming broadcast playing through Bubble Ghost on Game Boy Advance and beginning Twinsons Odyssey, then attempts to co-stream the Royal Rumble via Discord before raiding Serlar.
